qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Undisputed Nordic P&C market champion anchored by If P&C (~20% Nordic market share). Enjoys significant scale economies in claims handling, direct digital distribution, and IT, yielding an extraordinary ~81-83% combined ratio. Consistently indexes insurance tariffs above Nordic vehicle repair and bodily injury inflation while sustaining ~90% customer retention.

qualitative.evidence: Following the complete divestment of Nordea Bank and life insurance assets, Sampo is a pure-play P&C champion comprising If P&C, Topdanmark (fully acquired in 2024), and Hastings (UK). 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 15.5% (operating ROIC 25.1%). In FY25, net income was €1,998M with EBIT of €2,503M and owner EPS of €0.76. Combined ratio at If P&C remains steady at ~81-83%, demonstrating supreme underwriting discipline. Balance sheet is conservative with Debt/NI of 1.3x, interest coverage of 37x, and post-dividend Solvency II ratio of 174%.
